rules.statement: The impugned legislation should be upheld as it does not transgress the limits laid down by the Constitution and is aimed at conserving the jurisdiction of the courts rather than nullifying court decrees.
rules.supporting_quote: It is always a serious and responsible duty to declare invalid, regardless of consequences, what the national Parliament, representing the whole people of Australia, has considered necessary or desirable for the public welfare. The Court charged with the guardianship of the fundamental law of the Constitution may find that duty inescapable.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 6 of the Industrial Disputes (Special Provisions) Act, No. 37 of 1968

meta.parties: Tuckers Ltd v. Ceylon Merchantile Union
